sentences.text: Bacteroides eggerthii is one of the species of the Bacteroides fragilis group and related organisms, which a study describes as the most frequently isolated anaerobic pathogens from clinical samples.
That study used quantitative real-time PCR for these species in 400 human surgical wound infection samples or closed abscesses.

In 67 normal-weight and 71 obese Mexican children aged 6 to 12 years, a study reported Bacteroides eggerthii abundance significantly higher in obese children and correlated positively with body fat percentage.
In mice, a study identified Bacteroides eggerthii, given by gavage to wild-type mice, as a colitis-promoting species.
